title: In The Lab: Avalanche Tech Update - Unpacking ACP 176
description:
In The Lab: Avalanche Tech Update - Unpacking ACP 176
This call recapped the progress and results since the Etna and Fortuna upgrades, focusing on April’s ACP-176 “Octane” upgrade, which overhauled C-Chain fee dynamics. ACP-176 replaced the gas pricing mechanism with a smoother, more predictable system, removed the fixed minimum base fee, and introduced validator voting to adjust the network’s gas target dynamically. This change improved throughput consistency, lowered transaction costs, and gave validators more control. Overall, ACP-176 is seen as a foundation for scaling, enabling faster, cheaper transactions, more active network usage, and a pathway to higher throughput as validator consensus and infrastructure improvements allow.

Avalanche is a high-performance blockchain platform designed for builders who need to scale. Engineered with a revolutionary three-part Layer 1 (L1) architecture, Avalanche is anchored by its Avalanche Consensus Mechanism, ensuring near-instant finality for transactions. The platform also features an open-source Layer 0 (L0) framework, enabling the seamless creation of interoperable Layer 1 blockchains with high throughput on both public and private networks.

Supported by a global community of developers and validators, Avalanche offers a fast, low-cost environment for building the next generation of decentralized applications (dApps). With its unique blend of speed, flexibility, and scalability, Avalanche is the preferred choice for innovators pushing the boundaries of blockchain technology.

Supported by a global community of developers and validators, Avalanche offers a fast, low-cost environment for building the next generation of decentralized applications (dApps). ACP-176 replaced the gas pricing mechanism with a smoother, more predictable system, removed the fixed minimum base fee, and introduced validator voting to adjust the network’s gas target dynamically. This change improved throughput consistency, lowered transaction costs, and gave validators more control. Overall, ACP-176 is seen as a foundation for scaling, enabling faster, cheaper transactions, more active network usage, and a pathway to higher throughput as validator consensus and infrastructure improvements allow. Avalanche is a high-performance blockchain platform designed for builders who need to scale. Engineered with a revolutionary three-part Layer 1 (L1) architecture, Avalanche is anchored by its Avalanche Consensus Mechanism, ensuring near-instant finality for transactions. The platform also features an open-source Layer 0 (L0) framework, enabling the seamless creation of interoperable Layer 1 blockchains with high throughput on both public and private networks. Supported by a global community of developers and validators, Avalanche offers a fast, low-cost environment for building the next generation of decentralized applications (dApps). With its unique blend of speed, flexibility, and scalability, Avalanche is the preferred choice for innovators pushing the boundaries of blockchain technology.
